selection_reason: CSW-02 completed_verified in PR #415. The owner-approved APW/APM/CSW interleave now returns to APW-02, followed by APW-03 and APW-04 before APM-02.
objective: Define the asynchronous Action, proposal, delayed GM decision and durable inbox contract so one submitted proposal produces at most one attributable authoritative outcome through the existing Action/proposal/Event architecture, with explicit deadlines/expiration, edit/withdraw rules, stale-state handling, clarification loops, delegation, notification, reconnect and hidden-information-safe projections.
completion_gate: One durable delayed proposal produces at most one attributable authoritative outcome through the existing proposal/approval architecture with safe stale conflict clarification reconnect and notification behavior.
required_design_questions: How does an asynchronous proposal differ from a local draft, live Action intent and authoritative Event?
What stable IDs, expected versions, submitted snapshots and provenance must be frozen for delayed decisions?
What can a proposer edit or withdraw before decision, and what creates a new revision versus a new proposal?
How do deadlines, expiry, supersession and GM inbox ordering work without creating gameplay authority from queue position?
How does an authorized GM request clarification without modifying the Player's intent?
How are approve, modify-and-return, reject, expire and cancel outcomes represented through existing proposal/decision semantics?
What happens when Campaign/Character/target/rules state changes while the proposal waits?
How are permission revocation, role changes, Campaign lifecycle changes and delegation revalidated at decision/commit time?
How do notifications expose enough context to act without leaking hidden information?
How do reconnect/status lookup/idempotency guarantee at-most-one authoritative outcome after retries or ambiguous failures?
next_action: Execute APW-02 as a bounded design/governance tranche by reconciling A5/A6 Action-proposal authority, F006 approval loop, F021 recovery/idempotency and notification/visibility constraints into one durable delayed-proposal and GM-inbox contract.
